chunks: Yet verily your Lord is mighty and merciful.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah is both Al-Aziz and Al-Rahim?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse concludes the narrative of the prophets' struggles, offering theological reassurance that divine sovereignty (Al-Aziz) is inextricably linked with mercy (Al-Rahim). Shia exegetes highlight this pairing as a balance between Allah's ability to punish disbelievers and His compassion for the faithful, reinforcing the Prophet's patience during the Meccan period of rejection.
